content: Create an 80 × 50 mm mounting bracket with a 40 mm upright and 6 mm wall thickness. Add four 6 mm base mounting holes and a 16 mm cable opening in the upright.
An 80 × 50 mm mounting bracket with a 40 mm upright, four 6 mm mounting holes, and a 16 mm cable opening. All dimensions are in millimeters.
Make the bracket 100 mm wide. Keep the mounting holes 12 mm from each side and preserve the cable opening.
A 100 × 50 mm mounting bracket with a 40 mm upright, four 6 mm mounting holes, and a 16 mm cable opening. The mounting holes retain 12 mm side clearances. All dimensions are in millimeters.
